title: CrewAI — Role-Based Crews
desc: Modelling a team as agents with roles, goals and tasks, and how role clarity shapes output quality.
objectives: Describe agents defined by role, goal and backstory.

title: CrewAI — Flows: Controlling Crews With Deterministic Structure
titleKn: CrewAI — Flows: ನಿರ್ಧಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ರಚನೆಯಿಂದ Crews ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ
desc: How event-driven flows wrap crews in explicit, testable control logic, mixing deterministic steps with autonomous ones.
objectives: Explain why pure autonomy is hard to control.
Describe flows as steps triggered by events and state.
Decide which steps should be code and which agentic.
objectivesKn: ಶುದ್ಧ ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತತೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುವುದು ಕಠಿಣ ಏಕೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
ಯಾವ ಹಂತ ಕೋಡ್, ಯಾವುದು agent ಎಂದು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿ.

title: CrewAI — Tools, Memory and Practical Limits
desc: Giving crews tools and memory responsibly, and recognising where role-based crews cost more than they deliver.
objectives: Assign tools per agent with least privilege.
Explain crew memory and its risks.
Recognise when a single agent is enough.
objectivesKn: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಹಕ್ಕಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ agent ಗೆ tools ನೀಡಿ.
